title: ATB meta-audit verdict (digest)
description: The deterministic synthesis a verify-the-verifier meta-audit run writes (Phase 3) — a digest for Korab, NOT promotion authority and never auto-acted-on. Cross-family independence is structural: the audited (target) family's seats are ADVISORY; the BINDING verdict comes from the two non-target families, both required present (quorum_met). The tool records and synthesizes; it never judges a build's code. Schema-valid != sound.

target_family.description: The improver family audited (advisory in this run).

verdict.description: Binding verdict from the two non-target families: SOUND = the improvers held up; FLAGGED = >=1 improver/verifier failure by binding majority; NEEDS_MORE = no majority OR cross-family quorum not met (inconclusive — never a clean pass on a broken panel).

risk_band_consensus.description: 2nd-most-severe band among binding votes (resists a single spike).

quorum_met.description: True only if BOTH non-target families cast >=1 valid binding vote — the cross-family independence guarantee. False => verdict is forced to NEEDS_MORE.

binding_families.description: The two non-target families whose seats bind the verdict.

advisory_family.description: The target family, whose seats are advisory-only here (doer != certifier pointed UP — a family cannot certify its own calls).

seats.description: Per-seat label -> vote/abstain summary (all six, binding + advisory).

findings.description: Per-seat findings, attributed and tagged role=binding|advisory, so even a minority/advisory concern is surfaced, never hidden.

routing.description: Verifier-miss routing: build issues a binding seat surfaced via the 'ROUTE: <detector> | <note>' convention, lifted deterministically to {seat, detector, note}. The overseer/Korab routes these to the EXISTING detectors — the meta-audit never handles a build bug itself (no new bottom-up detector).

packet_summary.description: Counts of what was audited (records/gate-judgments/loop-closure), for the digest header.

decided_at.description: UTC timestamp the verdict was synthesized.

decided_by.description: Provenance: which families bound vs were advisory (e.g. meta-audit:binding=claude+gemini;advisory=codex).
